input.quote: 24.4 Customer's change of control does not give Vendor a right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service. Vendor shall cooperate with reasonable administrative changes needed to reflect a permitted successor.
input.rationale: Section 24 sits at (indeed substantially at) our preferred position. Customer may assign without Vendor consent both to an Affiliate (as defined in § 1.1) and to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets (24.1); Vendor may not assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without Customer's prior written consent, subject only to a reasonableness standard (24.2); other assignments are mutually consent-gated on a not-unreasonably-withheld basis (24.3); and Customer's change of control expressly gives Vendor no termination, suspension or repricing right (24.4). Section 13 (p0056) is consistent, letting Customer transfer licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in connection with a Section 24 assignment, and no termination provision contains a change-of-control trigger. The only shortfall against preferred wording is that the competitor bar reads "may never assign to a direct Customer competitor without Customer's consent" rather than an absolute prohibition; since 24.2 already blocks any Vendor assignment absent our consent, this is a minor sub-element noted for information only and not redlined.
